# Sushi Roll Sentrum

> Sushi takeaway in Bergen city centre (Håkonsgaten 17). Fresh sushi, sashimi, nigiri, poke bowls and special rolls for pickup or delivery via Wolt and Foodora. Takeaway only, no table booking. Sister restaurant with seating: Sushi Roll Sandviken (https://sushirollsandviken.no/).

- Address: Håkonsgaten 17, 5015 Bergen, Norway
- Phone: +47 457 38 120
- Email: post@sushiroll.no
- Opening hours: Wednesday–Sunday 15:00–21:30. Closed Monday and Tuesday.
- Cuisine: Japanese, sushi
- Price range: 200–300 NOK

## Order

- [Order takeaway (pickup)](https://order.gastroplanner.no/s/sushirollsentrum)
- [Delivery via Wolt](https://wolt.com/nb/nor/bergen/restaurant/sushi-roll-sentrum)
- [Delivery via Foodora](https://www.foodora.no/restaurant/n24h/sushi-roll-sentrum)
